svg.desc: A finite-element convergence experiment: Main starts the task, Coder, Executor and Review execute three complete rounds with illustrative RMSE 0.08, 0.04 and 0.02. The configured exit Agent Writer delivers errors.md. Agent cards label their Harness: Codex, DSH or pi, preserving the depicted configuration across recovery and intentional version changes.
